concept.title: Choosing the right place
concept.lead: Before you picture any house, there's a bigger decision: where to start.
concept.body1: SOLARA Lotes de Inversión starts from that idea: a place that's ready for people who know that building well begins with choosing the right ground.
concept.body2: SOLARA brings location, planning and access together in one starting point, about five minutes from the Caribbean Sea, in Mahahual.
concept.pillar1Text: A 180 to 255 m² lot with legal backing.
concept.pillar2Text: Hold it, build later or start now. You set the pace.
concept.pillar3Text: A solid base for your project, with the freedom to decide when to build. Subject to the development's regulations.
concept.name: The name nods to the energy of earth and sun, new beginnings and growth.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Common questions from lot buyers. Don't see yours? Message us.
faq.q1: Will I receive a deed for the lot?
faq.a1: The development includes a deed-based sale and a legal package with a deed with retention of title, the property deed, a registry filing receipt and a lien-free certificate. When the property deed is signed depends on your purchase option. Your advisor will explain it, and you can review it with your own attorney.
faq.q2: Does the development have an environmental impact statement (MIA)?
faq.a2: SOLARA has a Manifestación de Impacto Ambiental (MIA), Mexico's environmental impact statement. Ask your advisor for the documents so you can review them.
faq.a3: The development has authorized land use. You can review the documents with your advisor and with your own attorney or notary.
faq.a4: How you acquire a lot depends on your situation and on applicable Mexican law. Ask your advisor about the purchase structure: in the coastal zone it is usually a bank trust (fideicomiso). Confirm it with your own attorney or notary before you decide.
faq.a5: Yes. Book a private tour or presentation with your advisor and set the format and date together.
faq.q6: Is financing or a payment plan available?
faq.a6: SOLARA offers different ways to acquire a lot. Your advisor will confirm current terms when you request your quote.
faq.q7: What infrastructure does the development have?
faq.a7: The development includes urban planning, internal streets, curbs and preparation for utility connections. Ask your advisor which services are available and at what stage.
faq.q8: Can I build whenever I want?
faq.a8: The idea behind SOLARA is that you choose the timing: you can hold the lot and build later. Building is subject to the development's guidelines and applicable permits, which your advisor will detail.
faq.cta: Still have a question? Message us on WhatsApp
